newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas still down late, cash holds.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas still down late, cash holds.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures remained mostly lower late Tuesday in moderate trade, but a relatively steady physical market kept paper prices in recent technical ranges, industry sources said.
At 1445 EDT, May was still down by 1.3 cents at $1.94 per million British thermal units. June was 2.1 cents lower at $1.975. Most other deferreds were down slightly.

"We're in this 10-cent range between $1.85 and $1.95 (basis May), and we could stay that way until expiration (on April 24)," said one Texas-based trader, noting little reason to move much in either direction near-term.
